name: Hana no Himei ~Kowareta Garasu no Kokoro~
original_name: 華の悲鳴～壊れた硝子の心～
source:
The protagonist of this game is a bastard son of a rich man. Your father has died, and his legal son, your older brother, inherited all his money and property, including a mansion in the countryside. Knowing that your brother has left the country with his fiancee, you arrive at the mansion and unleash your rage and frustration on those who are left there - several innocent young girls...

Hana no Himei follows a linear story, with a chapter dedicated to each girl. After a series of pre-rendered images with text, you enter a 3D exploration mode, during which you'll have to walk around the mansion and find the girl who is hiding from you. Once you find her, you enter a "chase mode", during which you'll have to run and jump on the girl. Pressing and holding mouse buttons will make you attempt to overpower the girl, and deplete her "hit points". Once she runs out of HP, a 3D interactive sex scene begins.

[from [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/hana-no-hime]MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
这款游戏的主角是一个富翁的私生子。你的父亲去世了，他的合法儿子，也就是你的哥哥，继承了他所有的金钱和财产，包括一座乡村豪宅。得知你的兄弟已经带着他的未婚妻离开了这个国家，你到达了宅邸，并向留在那儿的人——几个无辜的年轻女孩——发泄了你的愤怒和沮丧……

《花之姬》讲述的是一个线性故事，每个女孩都有一个章节。在一系列带有文本的预渲染图像之后，你将进入3D探索模式，在此期间你必须在豪宅中走动并找到躲着你的女孩。一旦你找到她，你就会进入“追逐模式”，在此期间你必须奔跑并跳跃到女孩身上。按住鼠标按钮会让你试图制服女孩，并耗尽她的“生命值”。一旦她耗尽HP，3D互动性爱场景就会开始。

[来自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/hana-no-hime]MobyGames[/url]]
